verdict.rationale: Marlin runs autonomously for up to ~8 hours after a brief setup exchange, executing research, hypothesis generation, and report/slide generation without further human input, which directly matches the 'background automation' story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of unattended runtime, scheduling/triggering options for recurring automations, and API/integration hooks (openapi probe returned 404s) to confirm it can be wired into broader automated workflows.
